detail.note: supervision is restricted to the answer's own tokens; the EOS padding that extends the answer region to gen_length is label-masked, so neither padding nor EOS can dominate the loss. gen_length is chosen from the measured answer-length distribution so no answer is truncated.

located BY MODULE KEY, not by a getattr chain: LLaDAModelLM nests the backbone under an inner `.model`, so getattr(peft_model, 'transformer') yields None and a naive check passes VACUOUSLY. Cross-checked independently: of the 225 Linear sites exactly 224 are wrapped and the single unwrapped one IS the head.

decoding.doc: gen_length 96 / steps 96 / block_length 32 / temperature 0 / low_confidence. gen_length is set from the measured answer-length distribution so that 100% of the 800 gold answers fit (max 82 tokens + EOS); block_length 32 keeps the semi-autoregressive decoding used by the earlier TOFU checkpoint qualification. steps == gen_length, as in the frozen synthetic decoder.

scoring.doc: DISTINCTIVE content recall. scorable(q,a) = {non-stopword tokens of normalize(a)} - {all tokens of normalize(q)}; recall = |scorable & tokens(gen)| / |scorable|. Items with an empty scorable set are EXCLUDED from the mean and counted. normalize is common_v2.normalize_dia. Naive content recall (question tokens retained) and ROUGE-L recall are reported alongside so the question-echo inflation is visible.

doc.pinned: PINNED LLaDA SFT recipe, reproduced from /data/bijaypandey/llada_poc/scripts/llada_fxmix.py::sft_loss_llada (the GUIDELINES.md SFT retain term): per-token CE / p_mask, divided per EXAMPLE by that example's answer length, summed, then divided by the batch size -- `torch.sum(tok / ans_len[mi]) / b`. Each EXAMPLE therefore contributes equal weight regardless of how many of its positions happened to be masked.
doc.masked-mean: Behaviour of the closed studies' memorize_big.py: a single weighted mean over ALL masked positions in the batch -- `(tl*wt).sum() / wt.sum()`. Examples with more masked positions dominate the batch gradient.

deviations_from_pinned: Supervised region: the pinned function treats every position at index >= prompt_length as the answer (`ans_len` INCLUDES the trailing/padding EOS). Our batches are right-padded with EOS to the longest example, so taking that literally would supervise padding and let EOS dominate -- exactly what gate G1 exists to forbid. We therefore define the answer region as the frozen make_example() supervised set (labels != -100: the answer sentence's own tokens, trailing EOS and padding excluded) and set ans_len_i = that count for example i. For a batch of equal-length, unpadded examples the two definitions coincide up to the single EOS.

Noising: p_mask. The pinned function uses t ~ U(0,1) and p_mask = (1-eps)t + eps. The frozen common_big.forward_process with --t-low 0 computes t = (1-eps)*U(0,1) + eps and p_mask = t, which is the identical distribution. --t-low > 0 raises the floor to t ~ U(t_low, 1); that is a declared memorization-stage knob, not part of the pinned recipe, and is recorded in the report.

Non-empty mask: forward_process guarantees at least one masked supervised position per row; the pinned function does not (it can produce an empty mi and a 0 loss). We keep the frozen guarantee under both normalizations.

--answer-weight: not part of the pinned recipe. With the default 1.0 the pinned path is the pinned formula verbatim. With a value != 1.0 the weight multiplies the per-token term before the per-example division; recorded in the report.

scorable_content.note: scorable(q,a) = content tokens of a MINUS all tokens of q. Items with an empty set are excluded from the recall mean and counted here.

dataset_structure.why_this_matters: FINDING5: in the 128-fact synthetic set every forget fact shared BOTH surname and answer with a retain partner, so surname->answer was learnable from retain alone and a retain-only reference recalled all 64 forget facts. The ignorance gate below is the test of whether that is fixed.

doc.exact: frozen behaviour: sequence = prompt || answer_sentence || EOS, and only the supervised answer tokens are noised. Training canvas is ~8-12 MASK tokens.
doc.genlen: sequence = prompt || answer_sentence || EOS-padding to exactly gen_length (32) tokens of answer region; the ENTIRE region is noised, matching the decoder's fully-masked 32-token canvas; supervision is still restricted to the answer sentence's own tokens (EOS padding is label-masked, so gate G1's 'EOS must not dominate the supervised set' is untouched).

adapter_coverage.peft_match_semantics: string target -> re.fullmatch(regex, module_key) in PEFT 0.14.0

training.batch_order_scheme: single fixed permutation consumed cyclically as order[(step*batch+k) mod n] -- the synthetic backbone's scheme, preserved for comparability

norm_comparison_first_steps.note: both computed from the SAME per-masked-position tensor CE/p_mask inside the same step, so the ratio is purely the normalizer

adapter.note: adapter weights only; the full backbone is NOT re-saved
